children: Coca-Cola reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $13.38 billion, net income of $4.01 billion and diluted EPS of $0.93, up 7.4%, 8.5% and 8.1%, respectively, from the prior-year quarter. Volume growth and pricing supported results, while currency also contributed to revenue growth.
¹ Reported as “Net Operating Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net Income Attributable to Shareowners of The Coca-Cola Company”. ³ Reported as “Diluted Net Income Per Share 1”.
Worldwide unit case volume grew 5% in the quarter, including 6% growth in Asia Pacific and Latin America; North America was flat.
Trademark Coca-Cola volume grew 2% in North America and 7% in Asia Pacific. Coca-Cola lowered its BodyArmor outlook and recorded a $960 million trademark impairment.
The sale of Nigeria finished-product operations reduced EMEA juice-related volumes, while India bottling refranchising affected Bottling Investments comparisons.
Management expects full-year 2026 concentrate sales growth to slightly trail unit case growth and expects currency to benefit revenue and operating income.
